name: Nearja
title: Descendant of David
summary: Nearja is a descendant of King David through the line of Zerubbabel, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He is known primarily through genealogies that document the Davidic royal line after the exile. His name means 'servant of the Lord,' and he represents the continued preservation of David's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Neariah is listed as one of the sons of Shemaiah in the genealogy of David's descendants after the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: Father of Three Sons
keyEvents.description: Neariah had three sons: Eljoenai, Hizkiah, and Asrikam, who continued the Davidic line.

keyEvents.title: Part of Zerubbabel's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Through his place in the genealogy, Neariah connects the Davidic line from Zerubbabel to later generations after the return from exile.

keyEvents.title: Preservation of David's Line
keyEvents.description: Neariah's presence in the genealogy testifies to God's faithfulness in preserving David's line, in keeping with the promise of an eternal throne.

keyEvents.title: Another Neariah – A Descendant of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Another person named Neariah, son of Ishi, was one of the leaders of the Simeonites who defeated the Amalekites at Mount Seir.
